name: app-dark-navy-travel-booking-screen-sheet
title: Dark Travel Booking Screen Sheet
whatItIs: Eight phone screens on a charcoal board covering a booking flow: splash, sign-in, home, flight search, flight details, seat map, passenger form and hotel search, in dark grey UI with periwinkle-blue primary buttons.
whatItMeans: Dark cards and one soft blue create calm, premium travel. Showing the whole flow proves consistency.
techniques: Circled word in headlines as a hand-drawn accent
Gradient blue pill buttons on charcoal
Photographic sky and plane imagery for hero cards
Uniform grid of screens with identical bezels

vocabulary.definition: Many app screens laid out on a single board.
Pill buttons that switch a section's content.
A diagram of selectable seats in a vehicle.
